mapper.select:
SELECT a.user_id AS userId, u.user_name AS userName, a.balance, a.freeze_amount AS freezeAmount, DATE_FORMAT(a.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updateTime FROM u_account a LEFT JOIN user u ON a.user_id = u.id
AND a.user_id = #{userId}
AND u.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{userName}, '%')
ORDER BY a.balance DESC
SELECT balance FROM u_account WHERE user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE u_account SET balance = balance + #{amount}, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO u_account_log (user_id, type, amount, balance_after, order_no, remark, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{type}, #{amount}, #{balanceAfter}, #{orderNo}, #{remark}, NOW())
